title: effort r1 AIE: per-stage effort presupposes an unestablished control seam
description: Effort round 1. Lens: ai-engineer (validator: PE). Defect: the confirmed dispatch capability is prompt injection, but the API thinking budget is a request parameter no prompt can set; the fix-pass stage runs in the implementing session (session-dial surface) while cold rounds are dispatches (parameter surface) — two control planes conflated; a manifest could record an effort no seam applied. Citations verified: contract:91, :103 vs :293, :81. Proposed: resolved-candidate (state the two control surfaces honestly; the dispatch-parameter seam joins the manifest-injection seam as a named upstream capability requirement; until it lands, recorded effort for cold dispatches is the vehicle's session-level setting, recorded as such).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: two control surfaces stated honestly — session dial for the implementing session's work, dispatch parameter for cold dispatches as a named upstream capability requirement beside the manifest-injection seam; until it lands, a cold dispatch's recorded effort is the vehicle's session-level setting, recorded as such. Revision: Cost is knowable advisory clause.
